title: Safe Converter
story: Letters arrive with messy numbers. The post office must never crash on a bad one.
goal: Write to_int(text, default=0) that returns int(text), or default if the text is not a whole number.
hints: Wrap the risky conversion in try and catch ValueError.
socratic: Which line might raise an error?
What should the function return when it does?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Safe Converter”?
